answer: The system resists Sybil attacks through proof of history, where each identity builds its own 30-day record by carrying one 500-gram marble across a 200-meter island course and placing it on a scale at the marked point when the sun reaches its zenith; the scale records the weight and crossing time each day and compares them with the prior days, and a missing day, a weight under 500 grams, or a crossing time copied from another identity voids that record, so 100 fakes need 100 marbles and 100 separate daily crossings over 30 days.
